title: The Gymnastics Coach Who Made Girls Train in a Gas Chamber
hook: A coach locked young gymnasts in a sealed room filled with chemical fumes to 'expand their lung capacity' — it wasn't training, it was slow poisoning.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of children in a gas chamber is shocking and instantly raises questions about how far coaches go for medals.

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a ref using law enforcement tech to cheat feels like a spy thriller, making it highly shareable.
